variety_description: A high yielding, late maturity, semi-dwarf, medium grain variety released in Burundi in 2015. Variety is suitable for transplanting in upland ecosystems. It is tolerant to cold, and resistant to blast and sheathe rot. Has moderate threshability and with tolerance to lodging at maturity.
